units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>הוא אדום ותַבְשִׁילוֹ אדום</he> he (Esau) is red, and his dish is red.

<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:8">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ של שבת</he> the Sabbath dish.—<he>הקדיח ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S00125"><he>קָדַח</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּבְשִׁילִים</he>, <he>תַּבְשִׁילִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:7">Taan. IV, 7</cite>; a. fr.—<he>עירובי ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>.
